limits: Timing covers assembly, native builds, composition, local Wrangler dry-run and browser QA. Deployment/upload/hosted verification and final bundle transport were not performed in the benchmark.
Screenshots are retained and hash-verified evidence; this report does not claim comparison with M1 screenshots.
The cache upload sizes are authenticated job-log observations, not an authenticated repository cache inventory.
Preparation max RSS is a measured build subprocess peak, not Worker runtime memory or whole-job peak RAM.
Only pre-build runner filesystem capacity was logged; no measured peak/end disk use is available.

runStatus.failureReason: Original shared-contract invocation passed an unsupported --test-isolation=none flag to Node 22; aggregate gate correctly retained failure. All seven native build and QA lanes succeeded.

correctedContracts.skipReason: Windows-specific drive-root handler test skips on Linux by process.platform check.

forecast.method: For each of seven observed runners: fixed measured job overhead + one measured cold pack + (assigned count minus one) times that lane’s observed warm mean. Add measured plan/start offset and final gate delay. Max lane is forecast workflow wall.

fourSequentialBatches100.note: Supported 4-by-100 invocation shape, assuming one batch at a time at the measured seven-runner budget.

hypotheticalContinuous400.note: Model only: seven lanes stay warm across all 400. The implemented workflow accepts at most 100 packs per request.

overlappedFourBatches100.note: Unverified capacity scenario, not the default forecast; account deployment queue remains serial.

assumptions: Packs are already researched, migrated and ready; this benchmark used 25 mechanically rebound temporary clones of three proof packs (7 ZA / 1 Granada / 17 Wadi).
Same native release/toolchain and runner-speed distribution. Range scenarios combine observed fast/slow extrema, not statistical confidence intervals.
Fixed measured workflow overhead is retained. Extra final bundle sealing/transport/upload, increased report upload time, Cloudflare deployment and hosted QA are excluded.
No measured speed improvement is credited to the later cache-path normalization.

m1Baseline.basis: Owner-provided M1 model in the M2 request; not a measured 400-pack execution.
m1Baseline.comparison: M2 retains 2800 native build operations. Its measured-25-derived four-by-100 forecast is separate from the original 36-hour M1 model; final transport and live deployment remain outside this benchmark.

storage.cacheInventoryLimitation: GitHub connector does not expose the Actions cache inventory endpoint; actual upload sizes and successful save messages are authenticated job-log evidence.
storage.cacheVersionIssue: Measured run used lane-specific download-cache paths, so seven uploads succeeded with one displayed key. Fixed-path normalization is subsequent work, not measured here.

nativeFamilyAssetBytesPerPack.note: Sum of native family asset receipt sizes before composition/deduplication; not an uploaded deploy-transport size.
